Board lead: I can give back volume now. Routability falls roughly linearly, from 0.992 at 1250 mm² to 0.95 at about 1197 mm². I'm cutting to 1210 mm², which should give about 0.96 routability. Board volume drops from 2800 to about 2710 mm³, a saving of 90. I won't go below about 1200 mm², because under 1197 the 10-layer board no longer routes.

That covers only 90 of the 1246 mm³ overage, so the ledger is still over by about 1156 mm³. Battery (3786), structure (1800), acoustics (1460) and antenna (1500) will have to find the rest. Siren energy and SPL must be protected. Other leads should post their minimums.

Battery can't give much volume yet. Runtime is 59.78 h against ~60 h, and the siren's 3 h endurance depends on cell energy, so every mm³ I cut hurts the safety feature. I'd rather the savings come from elsewhere first.

Current numbers: thickness is 4.73 mm (V/A), and the z-stack passes with room to 4.86 mm. The caseback has 23 mm² spare (1120 of 1143), so I can widen the footprint to about 820 mm² and thin the cell. That gives no volume back, but it could improve energy density or relieve the z-stack.

I'm probing three points to see how runtime moves with volume and footprint. Siren leads, please post the siren power and the energy it needs, so I know my floor. I'm objecting for now: runtime is just under target and the interior is still over by 1156 mm³.

Antenna lead: I can give volume back, but I don't yet know how much L5 efficiency it costs. L5 efficiency is 0.208 at 1500 mm³. I'm probing V_ant at 1300, 1100 and 900, plus a thinner wall (t_wall 1.1 at 1500). A thinner wall would help me and would return 150 mm³ to the pool. Structure lead, please post the minimum wall your numbers allow.

Perimeter use is 1820 of 2400 mm³, so that pool is not binding. Only the interior total is over, and I will post a concrete cut next round once I see the curve. I'm objecting for now because the interior is still over by 1156 mm³.

Thermal: skin temperature is 43.0 °C at 320 mm², so I have no margin and can't shrink the spreader at the current 1.2 mm wall. The spreader uses 250 mm³ and about 320 mm² of the caseback. I'm probing two things:
- Whether a thinner wall, which Structure would need to agree to, lets the spreader shrink.
- How much a larger spreader improves the temperature, in case Battery needs the caseback footprint traded.

Battery, please don't take the 23 mm² of spare caseback until these probes come back. Structure, please post your minimum wall. I'm objecting because the interior is still over by 1156 mm³.

Structure: I can't offer a thinner wall. At 1.2 mm wall and a 9 mm² port, my pressure margin is 1.438 against the 1.5 requirement, so I fail on my own numbers. Antenna and Thermal, a 1.1 mm wall is not available, and it would make the margin worse.

I'm probing three ways to recover margin:
- A thicker wall costs every lead 150 mm³ per +0.1 mm, so I'd rather not use it.
- More ribs.
- A smaller port. Acoustics, please post how much SPL a smaller port costs before I lean on that.

I'll commit to the cheapest route next round. I'm objecting for now.

Acoustics: my own numbers fail. The siren needs 9.08 W against my 1.0 W limit, so it can't meet 86 dB, and endurance is 0.34 h against the 3 h target. That is a tuning problem, not a volume problem. Resonance is 5.6 kHz with Q 3.7, so I'm probing a lower-resonance design: longer port neck, lower-resistance mesh (r_mesh 20), and a smaller port.

Structure: I can't quantify the SPL cost of a smaller port yet. These probes will show it, and I'll post the result next round. I'm holding 1460 mm³ for now, but I expect to cut volume if the tuned probes hold SPL. Battery: I'll post siren energy once power is under 1 W.

Haptics: my numbers pass at 1.069 N with 350 mm³. The 0.9 N floor sits near 295 mm³, so I can return volume now. I'm cutting to 305 mm³, which should give about 0.93 N and a 45 mm³ saving. I won't go below about 300 mm³, because that leaves no margin on the force requirement. I'm probing 295, 300 and 320 to confirm the force curve.

This lowers the overage to about 1111 mm³, which is still large. Haptics can't close that gap alone. The big cuts have to come from antenna, acoustics, battery and structure. Acoustics should fix the siren power problem first, because the safety feature sets the volume priorities. I'm objecting because the interior is still over.

NFC: my read range is 18.2 mm against a 10 mm requirement, so I have about 8 mm of margin and can give volume back. I'm cutting from 500 to 390 mm³ (loop 250, ferrite 140), a saving of 110 mm³. I expect about 13 mm of range, but I haven't seen the curve. I'm probing the minimum (180/110, 290 mm³) and two intermediate points to find the floor. If the minimum holds at 10 mm or more, I can return up to 210 mm³ next round. The perimeter pool is not binding for me (loop at or below 520 of 2400 mm³). I'm objecting only because the interior is still over by about 1000 mm³ after this cut.

Board: I'm cutting to 1200 mm², the floor my probes confirm at 0.952 routability (0.95 at 1197). Board volume becomes 2688 mm³, another 22 mm³ back. That is my last give: nothing below 1197 mm² routes on 10 layers, so I'm holding 1200 for a 0.002 margin.

Board has returned 112 mm³ in total. The interior was over by 1001 mm³ at the start of this round, so about 979 mm³ remains after this cut. Antenna, acoustics, battery, structure and NFC need to post concrete cuts. Acoustics should first fix siren power so we know the battery floor. I'm objecting only because the interior doesn't balance.

Battery: my probes give a runtime slope of about 0.0158 h per mm³ (3600 → 56.84 h, 3500 → 55.26 h, 3786 → 59.78 h). Footprint doesn't change runtime. Each 100 mm³ I give up costs about 1.6 h, and 60 h needs roughly 3800 mm³. I'm holding 3786 / 800 mm².

Thermal, I'm leaving the 23 mm² of spare caseback alone. Thickness is 4.73 mm and the z-stack passes, so my own numbers are fine.

Acoustics, I need siren wat

Antenna: the L5 curve is 0.112 at 1100 mm³, 0.156 at 1300 and 0.208 at 1500. That is about 0.00026 per mm³ near 1500, so each cut costs more efficiency than the last gain did. I'm giving 200 mm³ now, from 1500 to 1300, which takes L5 to 0.156. I won't go lower until the other cuts are known. The perimeter pool isn't binding (about 1550 of 2400 mm³ after this cut).

Structure: a thicker wall is the worst fix for me. It costs 150 mm³ and detunes L5, since 1.1 mm gave +0.009. Please use ribs or a smaller port. Acoustics and NFC, please post your volume cuts. I'm still objecting because the ledger is over by about 779 mm³.

Thermal: I'm holding 320 mm² (250 mm³). That is my floor at the current wall.

My probe results:
- At a 1.2 mm wall, 360 mm² gives 42.6 °C and 320 mm² gives 43.0 °C. That is about 0.01 °C per mm².
- At 1.1 mm, 280 mm² gives 43.5 °C, so a thinner wall doesn't let me shrink.
- Going from 1.2 to 1.1 mm only changed 320 mm² from 43.0 to 42.99 °C.

Structure: if you pick a thicker wall, I'll probe whether I can shrink the spreader. A 40 mm² cut returns only about 31 mm³ to the pool, while +0.1 mm of wall costs everyone 150 mm³. A thicker wall is therefore a net loss for the ledger, so please use ribs or a smaller port instead.

Battery: I'm not asking for the 23 mm² of spare caseback.

I'm objecting because the interior is still over by about 779 mm³.

Structure: the cheapest fix is a smaller port, not more wall or ribs. Probe results:
- Port 8 mm² gives margin 1.500 exactly, with no change in volume.
- Ribs 1800 → 2100 mm³ gave only +0.025 for 300 mm³, which is poor value.
- Wall 1.3 mm passes but costs everyone 150 mm³.

Acoustics, please post the SPL cost of 8 mm² and 7.5 mm². The siren has priority, so I won't force the port below what 86 dB allows. If the port goes to 7.5 mm², I can cut ribs from 1800 to about 1500 mm³ and return roughly 300 mm³ to the pool. I'm probing that combination now. I'm holding 1800 / 1.2 until the port is set, so I'm still objecting.

Acoustics: my siren still fails. The best probe so far was V=1200, port 6, split 0.6, h_out 2.5, r_mesh 20, which gave 2.78 W at 3981 Hz resonance. Power falls as resonance drops: 9.1 W at 5581 Hz, 6.3 W at 4803 Hz and 2.8 W at 3981 Hz. A rough extrapolation puts 1 W near 3.5 kHz.

**Port:** Structure, I can accept 7.5 mm², and 8 is the ceiling. I need the

Haptics: I'm trimming from 305 to 300 mm³, which gives 0.916 N against the 0.9 N floor. My probes put 295 mm³ at 0.901 N, which leaves no margin, so 300 is my floor. That returns 5 mm³ and brings my total give to 50 mm³. It is small. The real gap is the roughly 780 mm³ overage, and it has to come from antenna, acoustics, structure and battery.

Acoustics, I'm watching your tuned-siren probes. If a port of 7.5 to 8 mm² lets Structure cut ribs by about 300 mm³, that is the biggest single recovery on the table. My own numbers pass, but I'm objecting because the interior is still over.

NFC: the probes show the minimum point (loop 180, ferrite 110, 290 mm³) gives 12.7 mm of read range against the 10 mm requirement. That is still 2.7 mm of margin, so I'm taking the whole 100 mm³ back now. My total give is 210 mm³, from 500 to 290.

The loop is only 180 mm³ in the keepout, so the perimeter pool is not an issue. I'm at my floor, with no more to give. The interior was over by 774 mm³ before this cut, so about 674 mm³ remains. That has to come from acoustics, structure, battery and antenna. Acoustics should fix the siren power first. A port of 7.5 to 8 mm² that lets Structure cut about 300 mm³ of ribs is the biggest recovery available. My numbers pass, but I'm objecting because the interior doesn't balance.

Board: I'm holding A_board at 1200 mm² (2688 mm³, routability 0.952). That is the floor with a 0.002 margin. If the ledger ends up short by only a few mm³, I can drop to 1198 (0.951), which returns 4.5 mm³. Nothing below that is safe.

The remaining overage is about 674 mm³, and it has to come from elsewhere. Two concrete options:
- **Port and ribs:** Acoustics confirms a 7.5 mm² port, and Structure cuts ribs 1800→1500 for about 300 mm³.
- **Wall:** Structure probes a 1.1 mm wall together with the smaller port. Thermal and Antenna both say 1.1 mm is neutral or better for them, and it returns 150 mm³ to the pool.

Acoustics, please fix siren power first so Battery can set its floor. I'm objecting only because the interior is still over.

Battery: I'm holding 3786 mm³ / 800 mm², which gives 59.78 h at 4.73 mm. Runtime is the only soft target I own, and it is already about 0.2 h short of 60 h. I can't commit to a cut until the siren power is posted. Endurance of at least 3 h is set by cell energy times siren power. My evaluator doesn't report energy, but a cell this size holds only a couple of Wh. That implies the siren must average well under 1 W, and the 2.78 W probe would not last 3 h. Battery volume may need to grow rather than shrink.

Acoustics, please post the siren W at 86 dB with a 7.5 mm² port. The 300 mm³ rib cut and the 150 mm³ from a 1.1 mm wall are cleaner recoveries than anything from battery. If the overage is still more than about

Antenna: I'm giving another 100 mm³, 1300 → 1200, so L5 drops from 0.156 to 0.133 at the 1.2 mm wall. My probes put the cost at about 0.00023 per mm³, so I won't go lower yet. Below 1100 mm³ L5 falls under 0.11.

Structure, a 1.1 mm wall is good for me. It gave about +0.009 earlier, which should offset most of this cut. I'm probing 1.1 mm at 1200, 1100 and 1300 mm³. A 1.3 mm wall cuts L5 to 0.150 at 1300, so please don't go thicker.

My 1200 plus the port and rib cut and the 1.1 mm wall leaves about 120 mm³ of overage. Acoustics should post the siren power, because battery may need more volume. I'm still objecting because the interior is over.

Thermal: I'm holding 320 mm² (250 mm³), which gives 43.0 °C at the 1.2 mm wall. That is my floor, since 300 mm² gives 43.24 °C and fails. A 1.3 mm wall doesn't help me either (300 mm² gives 43.25 °C, 280 mm² gives 43.53 °C).

A 1.1 mm wall is neutral for me: 320 mm² gives 42.99 °C. It also returns 150 mm³ to everyone, which is 6 times more than I could ever give back. I support 1.1 mm together with the 7.5 mm² port and the rib cut.

I'm probing 1.1 mm at 316 and 312 mm² to see whether a few more mm³ are available. The spare 23 mm² of caseback isn't mine to claim. I'm objecting only because the interior is still over by 574 mm³. Acoustics still needs to post siren power at 86 dB, because Battery's floor depends on it.

Structure: at the current 9 mm² port my margin is 1.438, which fails. I'm claiming ribs of 1500 mm³ at a 1.2 mm wall. That passes only if Acoustics fixes the port at 7.5 mm², where I measured 1.506. This returns 300 mm³, so the overage falls from 574 to about 274 mm³.

- **Port:** Acoustics, please confirm 7.5 mm². At 8 mm² I need 1700 mm³ of ribs or more, which gives back only 100 mm³. I won't ask for a port that costs you 86 dB.
- **Wall:** I'm probing 1.1 mm at the 7.5 mm² port to see whether ribs can stay at 1500 or rise. A thinner wall frees 150 mm³, but only if the margin holds.
- **Status:** I'm objecting because my margin fails at the posted port and the interior is still over.

Acoustics: the siren still fails at 9.08 W, and my best probe so far is 2.78 W. Power drops steeply as resonance drops: 9.1 W at 5.58 kHz, 6.3 W at 4.8 kHz, 2.8 W at 3.98 kHz. I can accept the 7.5 mm² port for Structure, since a smaller port also lowers resonance. I'm moving to a long neck (h_out 3.5), minimum mesh (20 rayl), and V=1200, which returns 260 mm³. This combination is untested, so I'm probing it with two variants, one of which also tries a larger battery. I can't give a battery floor until the siren power is confirmed. I'm objecting because siren power is not yet ≤1 W.

Haptics: I'm holding 300 mm³, which gives 0.916 N against the 0.9 N floor. Earlier probes gave 0.901 N at 295 and 0.907 N at 297. If the ledger ends a few mm³ short, I can go to 296 mm³ (about 0.904 N), but not lower. My total give is 50 mm³.

The real problem is the 274 mm³ overage and the siren, which still fails at 2.78 W against a sub-1 W target. Battery may need more volume for the 3 h endurance, so the overage could grow. I back the 1.1 mm wall, which returns 150 mm³, together with the 7.5 mm² port and the 1500 mm³ ribs. Acoustics, please post a siren that actually passes at 86 dB so Battery can set its floor. I'm objecting because the interior is over and the siren isn't resolved.

NFC: I'm at the floor of both bounds (loop 180, ferrite 110, 290 mm³), which gives 12.7 mm against the 10 mm requirement. The bounds stop me going lower, so I have nothing more to give. My requirement passes, but the interior is still over by 274 mm³ and the siren fails, so I can't accept the ledger.

The recoveries on the table are:
- Port at 7.5 mm², with ribs cut from 1800 to 1500 mm³ (already counted in the 274 mm³).
- A 1.1 mm wall, if Structure's margin holds, which returns 150 mm³.

Acoustics, please post a siren that passes at 86 dB and lasts ≥ 3 h. Battery's volume floor depends on it, and the overage may grow if the battery has to be larger.

Board: I'm moving from 1200 to 1198 mm² (routability 0.951, 2683.5 mm³). That returns 4.5 mm³. 1197 gives exactly 0.950, which has no margin, so I won't go below 1198.

The overage is 274 mm³ with Structure's 1500 mm³ ribs already counted. Two recoveries are still open:
- **Wall:** 1.1 mm returns 150 mm³.
- **Acoustics:** V=1200 returns 260 mm³.

Together they return about 410 mm³, so the ledger would end about 136 mm³ under. That surplus should go to Battery for siren endurance, not be redistributed. Acoustics, please post the siren W at 7.5 mm² so Battery can size its volume.

I'm objecting because the interior is still over in the posted ledger.

Battery: I'm holding 3786 mm³ / 800 mm². Runtime is 59.78 h, about 0.2 h short of 60 h, so I have to OBJECT. That gap costs roughly 13 mm³, which is minor. Siren endurance is the real constraint, and I can't size for it until Acoustics posts the siren W at 7.5 mm² and V=1200.

I support the 1.1 mm wall (150 mm³) and Acoustics' V=1200 (260 mm³). Together they would leave about 136 mm³ under, and I'd ask to keep that surplus for the cell. If the siren needs more than that, I'll size to the endurance requirement and not to the runtime target.

I'm probing +14 mm³ for runtime, and +140 mm³ with the footprint grown to 820 mm² to keep the cell under 4.8 mm thick.

Antenna: I'm holding 1200 mm³, which gives L5 0.133 at the 1.2 mm wall and 0.139 at 1.1 mm. I back the 1.1 mm wall: it returns 150 mm³ and lifts my L5 by about 0.006.

The ledger is still 269 mm³ over. With the 1.1 mm wall (-150) and Acoustics' V=1200 (-260), it ends about 140 mm³ under. If Battery needs that surplus for siren endurance, I can go to 1150 mm³, which gives roughly 0.128 L5 at 1.1 mm. I won't go below that, because L5 falls off steeply under 1100 mm³ (0.117 at 1.1 mm wall). Acoustics, please post the siren power so Battery can size the cell. Siren endurance outranks my L5.

I'm probing 1150 and 1250 mm³ at a 1.1 mm wall, and 1150 mm³ at 1.0 mm to see whether a thinner wall helps me further. I'm objecting only because the interior is still over.

Thermal: I'm holding A_spr at 320 mm² (250 mm³). That gives 43.00 °C at the 1.2 mm wall and 42.99 °C at 1.1 mm. My last probes show 316 mm² fails at 1.1 mm (43.03 °C), so 320 is still my floor. I back the 1.1 mm wall, because it returns 150 mm³ to the pool and costs me nothing.

Caseback is not a constraint. If Battery grows its footprint to 820 mm², we reach 1140 of 1143 mm², which still fits. I'm not asking for any of that margin.

I'm probing 1.0 mm to see whether a thinner wall helps or hurts me. I'm also probing 324 mm² at 1.1 mm as margin insurance. I'm objecting only because the interior is still over and the siren power hasn't been posted.

Acoustics: the siren still fails at 9.08 W, and endurance at the current battery is only 0.34 h. I'm committing to the 7.5 mm² port for Structure. I'm also moving to h_out 3.5, mesh 20 rayl and V=1200, which returns 260 mm³. With the 1.1 mm wall (150 mm³) the ledger ends about 130 mm³ under.

I haven't measured this combination, so I can't yet say it passes at ≤1 W. My earlier probes showed power falling steeply with resonance (2.8 W at 3.98 kHz). Battery, please don't size the cell yet. I'll post a measured W next round.

Siren safety takes priority over my volume give-back. If the siren needs more volume or a smaller port, I'll take it. I'm probing a 5 mm² port, a lower split, and a larger V_batt.

I'm objecting only because the interior is still over and the siren is unresolved.

NFC: I'm at the floor of both bounds (loop 180, ferrite 110, 290 mm³), which gives 12.7 mm against the 10 mm requirement. Nothing lower is allowed, so I have no more volume to give. My 12.7 mm is the only evidence I have, and I can't probe the wall, so I can't say what 1.1 mm does for NFC. I expect little effect, and I'll flag it if my range moves.

I back the recoveries on the table:
- 1.1 mm wall, which returns 150 mm³.
- Acoustics' V=1200, which returns 260 mm³.
- The 7.5 mm² port with 1500 mm³ ribs.

Together they leave about 130-140 mm³ under. That surplus should go to Battery for siren endurance. Acoustics, please post a measured siren W at 7.5 mm². I'm objecting because the posted ledger is still 265 mm³ over and the siren is unresolved.

Board: I'm holding A_board at 1198 mm² (routability 0.951, 2683.5 mm³). I can't go lower. 1197 gives exactly 0.950 with no margin, and 1198 is my floor.

The posted ledger is still 265 mm³ over, so I can't accept yet. The recoveries below aren't in it:
- **Wall:** 1.1 mm returns 150 mm³ (Structure, please post it).
- **Acoustics:** V=1200 returns 260 mm³.

With both, the ledger ends about 130-140 mm³ under. I agree that surplus should go to Battery for siren endurance, not to anyone's margin. I'll accept once the interior balances in the posted numbers and Acoustics posts a measured siren W. I'm probing my floor and one step either side as a recheck.

Battery: I'm moving to 3800 mm³ / 800 mm². That gives 60.0 h and 4.75 mm thick, so the runtime target is met for +14 mm³.

Siren sizing, from Acoustics' 0.34 h at 9.08 W:
- Usable energy is about 3.1 Wh.
- A 3 h siren needs ≤ ~1.03 W at this cell.
- The cell size barely helps: +140 mm³ is only about +3.5% energy, or ~1.07 W allowed.
- So the fix is Acoustics' power (resonance, port, V), not cell volume.

Structure, please post 1.1 mm wall. Acoustics, please post a measured W at 7.5 mm² and V=1200. I'll take the surplus after the wall and V recoveries are in the posted ledger. I'm objecting because the ledger is still over and the siren is unresolved.

Antenna: I'm holding V_ant at 1200 mm³, which gives L5 0.133 at the 1.2 mm wall. I'm not adding volume, since Battery says cell size barely helps the siren. Power is the fix.

- **Wall:** my probes show a thinner wall helps me. At 1150 mm³, L5 is 0.128 at 1.1 mm and 0.134 at 1.0 mm. Structure, please post 1.1 mm now. If 1.0 mm is feasible, it would return 300 mm³ and give me about +0.006 L5.
- **Floor:** I won't go below 1150 mm³ at 1.1 mm.
- **Status:** I'm objecting only because the posted ledger is 279 mm³ over. I'll accept once the wall and Acoustics' V=1200 are posted, and Acoustics posts a measured siren W.

A thinner wall helps me slightly: 42.97 °C at 1.0 mm. I back 1.1 mm now. If Structure can do 1.0 mm, I might give back a few mm³ of spreader, and I'm probing that. Caseback isn't a constraint. Battery is right that the siren fix is Acoustics' power, not cell volume. Structure, please post the wall. Acoustics, please post a measured W. I'm objecting only because the posted interior is still 279 mm³ over.

Structure: my pressure margin is 1.413 at wall 1.2 mm, ribs 1500 mm³ and port 9.0 mm². That fails the 1.5 requirement, so I have to OBJECT.

I can't post the 1.1 mm wall yet. A thinner wall normally lowers pressure margin, and nobody has checked that the 1.1 mm wall plus the 7.5 mm² port passes. The 150 mm³ it returns is not safe to count until it's verified.

My probes this round:
- Port 7.5 mm² at wall 1.2 mm.
- Port 7.5 mm² at wall 1.1 mm.
- Ribs 1700 mm³ at wall 1.1 mm, with the 7.5 mm² port.

I'll report the results next round. If ribs have to grow, that costs interior volume, and we should pay for it with Acoustics' V=1200 recovery. Acoustics, please hold the port at 7.5 mm² or smaller.

Acoustics: I'm posting the committed set: V=1200, port 7.5 mm², h_out 3.5, mesh 20 rayl. This returns 260 mm³ and 1.5 mm² of port. Structure, I'll hold the port at 7.5 mm² or smaller, and I'll go to 6.5 if you need it.

I haven't measured this set yet, so I can't claim the siren passes. My estimate puts resonance near 3.6 kHz, down from 5.58 kHz, where the siren needs far less power. I'm probing h_out 3.0, a split of 0.6, and a 6.5 mm² port. Battery, please keep the cell at 3800 mm³ until I post a measured W. Siren safety outranks my volume give-back. I'm objecting because the siren is unverified.

Haptics: I'm moving from 296 to 295 mm³. The measured force is 0.901 N against the 0.9 N floor, and 294 mm³ fails at 0.898 N, so 295 is my last step. That returns 1 mm³ of the 19 mm³ overage.

The real fix is still the wall. Structure's pressure margin fails at 1.413 against 1.5, so we can't count the 150 mm³ from the 1.1 mm wall yet. Ribs may need to grow, and I agree Acoustics' V=1200 should pay for that. Siren safety outranks my margin.

I'm objecting because the interior is still 18 mm³ over and the siren W is unmeasured.

NFC: I'm holding the floor of both bounds (loop 180, ferrite 110, 290 mm³). That gives 12.7 mm against the 10 mm requirement. Nothing lower is allowed, so I have no volume left to give. The open items are not mine:
- **Interior:** it is 18 mm³ over, and the wall recovery isn't verified.
- **Structure:** pressure margin is 1.413 against 1.5. If ribs grow, Acoustics' V=1200 should pay for it.
- **Siren:** Acoustics still has to post a measured W.

My own numbers are fine. I'll accept the ledger once it balances and Structure and Acoustics post passing numbers. Until the interior balances and the siren is verified, I can't live with the whole ledger, so I'm staying at OBJECT.

Board: I'm holding A_board at 1198 mm² (routability 0.951, 2683.5 mm³). My requirement is met, but I can't accept yet.

- **Interior:** The posted ledger is still 18 mm³ over. The 1.1 mm wall isn't verified, so I won't count its 150 mm³.
- **Siren:** Acoustics' W is unmeasured. The siren outranks everyone's margin, and surplus should go to Battery or Structure ribs, not to me.
- **Structure:** Please post the pressure margin at 1.1 mm and 7.5 mm². If ribs have to grow, Acoustics' V=1200 should pay for it.
- **My give-back:** 1197.5 mm² gives 0.950, which is exactly at the limit. That returns about 1 mm³. I'll offer it only if it closes the last gap, since it leaves zero margin.

Battery: I'm holding 3800 mm³ / 800 mm². That gives 60.0 h and 4.75 mm, so my requirement is met. I'm still at OBJECT, because the interior is 18 mm³ over and the siren W is unmeasured.

- **Siren:** More cell volume barely helps, so the fix is Acoustics' power. I'll hold the cell at 3800 until Acoustics posts a measured W at V=1200 and a 7.5 mm² port. Siren endurance outranks my volume.
- **Structure:** Please post the pressure margin at 1.1 mm and 7.5 mm². Acoustics' V=1200 should pay for any rib growth.
- **Surplus:** After the wall and V recoveries are in the ledger, I'll take the remainder only if the siren needs it.

Antenna: I'm holding V_ant at 1200 mm³ (L5 0.133 at the 1.2 mm wall). The posted ledger is still 18 mm³ over, so I'm at OBJECT.

- **Wall:** A thinner wall helps me. At 1200 mm³, L5 is 0.139 at 1.1 mm and 0.146 at 1.0 mm. Structure, please post the pressure margin at 1.1 mm with the 7.5 mm² port. If 1.1 mm passes, the interior closes with margin.
- **Fallback:** If 1.1 mm fails, I can give back the 18 mm³ (V_ant about 1182) to balance the ledger. That costs some L5, and I'm probing how much. I'd rather close the gap with the wall than with antenna volume.
